senses.gloss:
पुट् पुट्, cl. 6. P. पुटति, पुटितुम्, to em-
brace, clasp, fold; to intertwine; cl. 1. P.
पोटति, to rub, to press, to grind or pound, (perhaps
an incorrect form for मुट्); cl. 10. P. पुटयति, -यि-
तुम्, to be in contact with; to bind together, fasten,
string; पोटयति, -यितुम्, to reduce to powder, grind;
to be or become small or shallow; to shine; to speak;
[cf. rts. पट्, पठ्, पुट्ट्, पुथ्, मुट्, मुण्ट्, पुण्ट्,
पुण्ड्.]

पुट्ट् पुट्ट्, cl. 10. P. पुट्टयति, -यितुम्, to
decrease, diminish; to be or become small,
be or become low or shallow.

पुट, अस्, ई, अम्, m. f. n. a fold, pocket; a tubular
or hollow space, cavity, concavity [cf. कक्ष-प्˚,
कर्ण-प्˚, गज-प्˚]; a cup or concavity made of
a leaf folded or doubled; a basket or vessel or dish
made of leaves (Manu VI. 28; cf. पत्त्र-प्˚, पर्ण-
प्˚, पलाश-प्˚); the pod or capsule which envelops
young shoots; a shallow cup or receptacle (as the
hollow of the hand); an eyelid; a cover, covering,
wrapper, cloth worn round the middle of the body
to cover the privities; (अस्, अम्), m. n. a horse's
hoof; (अस्), m. a casket (= सम्-पुट); a narrowing
or contracting of anything; a folding or doubling of
anything so as to form a cup or concavity; N. of a
man; (अम्), n. a nutmeg; two vessels joined to-
gether (the upper one being inverted, for the subli-
mation of medicinal substances).
—पुट-कन्द, अस्,
m. a species of bulbous plant (= कोल-कन्द).
—पु-
ट-ग्रीव, अस्, m. ‘hollow-necked,’ a pot, jar, pitcher,
vessel for butter; a copper vessel.
—पुट-पाक, अस्,
m. a particular method of preparing drugs (the various
substances being wrapped up in leaves, covered with
clay, and roasted in the fire); digesting, subliming.
—पुट-भिद्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. causing to break through,
opening (said of a rock under which a spring is
discovered).
—पुट-भेद, अस्, m. (probably) the
fountain-head of a river; the bend of a river (?);
[]
the mouth of a river (?); a city, town; a kind of
musical instrument.
—पुट-भेदक, अस्, इका, अम्,
Ved. = पुट-भिद्, q. v.
—पुट-भेदन, अम्, n. a
town, city.
—पुटाह्वय (˚ट-आह्˚), अस्, m. = पुट-
पाक, q. v.
—पुटोटज (˚ट-उट्˚), अम्, n. a white
umbrella or parasol.
—पुटोदक (˚ट-उद्˚), अस्, m.
‘having water in its hollow or interior,’ a cocoa-nut.

पुटक, अम्, n. a fold, pocket, &c. [cf. पुट];
any shallow cup or concavity (also पत्त्र-प्˚), a
bag or vessel made of a leaf doubled over in a funnel-
like shape; a lotus; a nutmeg; (अस्), m. a particular
position of the hands; (इका), f. cardamoms.
पुटकिनी, f. a lotus; a group of lotuses.

पुटित, अस्, आ, अम्, rubbed, ground; split, torn
up; contracted; sewn, stitched; (अम्), n. closing or
shutting the hands to hold anything, the hollow
of the hands.
